items.q: What is banned inside an addon?
items.a: **No HTTP, no sockets, no localhost, no arbitrary file reads.** Import does **not hot-reload**. Saved variables are written on **reload or logout**. The combat log is restricted. The game is out **4 November**.

items.q: What did the legacy window do?
items.a: Pressing **Y** grants alt points. Everyone in the beta was given **16**. A **fubar** dropdown appeared because an extra-challenges dropdown **reused an existing screen**.

items.q: What tooling did they settle on?
items.a: The **Codex** app, **one local git repo per addon**, and **/reload**. **Cursor** was the easiest. Codex on **Soul 61**, medium or high, is plenty. A fast expensive model is about **$500 a month** for about **90 minutes a week**. **Don't use Fable. It is too slow.**

items.q: How did an addon ping Discord?
items.a: A text-replacement addon pinged a user via a **numeric id in brackets**. A **guild ping** already exists. Companion programs **outside the game** can scan the disk for secrets.
A companion program **outside the game** can scan the disk. Inside the addon there is still **no socket**.
